noun_definition: A carousel arrow is a navigational element that allows users to move between items in a carousel interface.
noun_functionality: The functionality related to carousel arrows includes managing their visibility based on user interaction and automatically hiding them after a period of inactivity.

noun_definition: A carousel arrow is a navigational element that allows users to cycle through items in a carousel interface.
noun_functionality: The carousel arrows control the navigation between different attachments in the carousel, enabling users to move forward or backward through the items.

noun_functionality: The Carousel Arrow functionality is responsible for enabling users to cycle through attachments by incrementing or decrementing the current page index, and it manages the visibility of the arrows based on user interactions.

noun_definition: Carousel arrows are UI elements that allow users to navigate through items in a carousel interface.
noun_functionality: The function manages the visibility of the carousel arrows based on user interactions, such as scaling and tapping, to enhance navigation within the carousel.

noun_definition: An arrow icon is a graphical representation of an arrow used to indicate direction or action.
noun_functionality: The function renders an arrow icon that can be styled based on its direction and whether it is disabled.

noun_definition: A time picker arrow is a user interface element that allows users to navigate between input fields for hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds in a time selection component.
noun_functionality: The time picker arrow functionality enables users to move focus between different time input fields (hour, minute, second, millisecond) using keyboard arrow keys, enhancing the user experience in selecting time values.
